summary: RE-REVIEW round 5 of run_id iterate-2026-09-22-r3-review-diff-fix (branch iterate/campaign-r3-review-diff-fix @ e17c24a88) after doubt-reviewer round 2 (0 high / 3 medium / 4 low) and code-reviewer round 4 low remediation. A git failure inside the helper returns None and still fails closed (ship raises ReviewAttributionError, verify returns ok=False). (2) campaign-mode.md 3f-bis L356-363 re-derives run_dir and pr_url after the a/b/c spawns via {project_root}/{branch}: same spec-named call sites (L19-25: run_dir, gh pr view branch resolution) scoped to {project_root} with the shared-worktree fallback - no change to the unit-scoping contract. (4) _load_pin isinstance guard (L144): malformed non-dict pin raises the module's documented ReviewAttributionError instead of an uncaught AttributeError; fails closed either way, contract unchanged. (5) 3g L452 `gh pr merge ... $head_pin || STRICT-STOP` and bounded MERGED wait L456-463: merge still carries --match-head-commit from the legacy file (spec L25-31); the bound is hardening that neither changes the contract nor risks the acceptance test - in-scope under 'Same set for 3g' (L25). No missing, unfaithful, out-of-scope, or contradictory change among the six; no new divergence introduced. Non-blocking note for Stage 2 (not a spec matter): the _SHA_RE comment at review_attribution.py:70-72 still says the SHA flows into `git rev-parse {sha}^`, which is now `rev-list --parents`.
